patch_description: The current program uses a greedy seed with 4 ordering variants and a move-only local search that only targets the single worst GPU. The new program adds: (1) a swap operator (exchange a model on the worst GPU with a model on another GPU) which enables improvements when no single move fits in memory, and (2) after the worst-GPU phase stalls, a second phase targeting the runner-up GPU, both gated with 1e-12 strict-improvement thresholds. It also increases move iterations (40→80) and keeps the multi-seed restarts to escape bad greedy orders. These extensions generalize the proven move pattern and broaden the neighborhood so the max KVPR can drop further.
